content: EAV is widely treated as an antipattern for known attributes: pivoting queries, no type enforcement, no FK integrity, unusable filters. Community and expert consensus (r/PostgreSQL, DBA.SE, Evolveum midScale design docs) is typed columns for known/common fields plus JSONB only for genuinely dynamic extras; Evolveum measured JSONB roughly 2x faster than EAV with less storage. JSONB caveat: no schema enforcement without CHECK constraints; risk of schema sprawl.
